activities.title: Listen. Maya shows Ingrid the new flat. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Maya: Come in, Ingrid! This is the living room. … Ingrid: I love the yellow sofa! And what a big shelf! … Maya: Yes, it has space for two hundred books. … Ingrid: Where is your science laboratory? … Maya: In the basement! It's a bit dark, but very quiet. … Ingrid: And this door? … Maya: That's the balcony. You can see the sea from there! … Ingrid: Beautiful! Where does Kili sleep when he visits? … Maya: On the roof, of course. He says it's the best bedroom in the city!
